login_identities_provider_profile_check.name: login_identities_provider_profile_check
login_identities_provider_profile_check.value: "account"."login_identities"."provider" <> 'password' OR ("account"."login_identities"."provider_email" IS NULL AND "account"."login_identities"."provider_display_name" IS NULL)

sessions_revoke_reason_check.name: sessions_revoke_reason_check
sessions_revoke_reason_check.value: revoke_reason IS NULL OR revoke_reason IN ('logout', 'logout_all', 'password_changed', 'password_reset', 'email_verified', 'member_removed', 'user_disabled', 'identity_link_reset', 'account_joined', 'account_claimed')

users_deletion_notice_check.name: users_deletion_notice_check
users_deletion_notice_check.value: "account"."users"."deletion_notice_sent_at" IS NULL OR "account"."users"."detached_at" IS NOT NULL

model_prices_positive_matches_unit.name: model_prices_positive_matches_unit
model_prices_positive_matches_unit.value:
(
        "unit" = 'token'
        AND "input_per_mtok" IS NOT NULL AND "input_per_mtok" > 0
        AND "output_per_mtok" IS NOT NULL AND "output_per_mtok" > 0
        AND ("cached_input_per_mtok" IS NULL OR "cached_input_per_mtok" > 0)
        AND "per_minute" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "unit" = 'audio_minute'
        AND "per_minute" IS NOT NULL AND "per_minute" > 0
        AND "input_per_mtok" IS NULL AND "output_per_mtok" IS NULL AND "cached_input_per_mtok" IS NULL
      )

posts_account_scheduled_idx.name: posts_account_scheduled_idx
posts_account_scheduled_idx.where: "content"."posts"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "content"."posts"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL

posts_approved_has_schedule.name: posts_approved_has_schedule
posts_approved_has_schedule.value: "content"."posts"."status" <> 'approved' OR ("content"."posts"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "content"."posts"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "content"."posts"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

media_account_file_hash_key.name: media_account_file_hash_key
media_account_file_hash_key.where: "media"."media"."file_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."media"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "media"."media"."status" IN ('processing', 'ready')

media_ready_complete.name: media_ready_complete
media_ready_complete.value: "media"."media"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("media"."media"."file_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."media"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."media"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."media"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL)

upload_sessions_multipart_shape.name: upload_sessions_multipart_shape
upload_sessions_multipart_shape.value: ("media"."upload_sessions"."mode" = 'multipart' AND "media"."upload_sessions"."part_size_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."upload_sessions"."part_count" IS NOT NULL) OR ("media"."upload_sessions"."mode" = 'single' AND "media"."upload_sessions"."multipart_upload_id" IS NULL AND "media"."upload_sessions"."part_count" IS NULL)

channel_connections_disconnected_no_toke.name: channel_connections_disconnected_no_token
channel_connections_disconnected_no_toke.value: "platform_gateway"."channel_connections"."status" <> 'disconnected' OR ("platform_gateway"."channel_connections"."token_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "platform_gateway"."channel_connections"."refresh_ciphertext" IS NULL)

publish_attempts_submitted_stamp_check.name: publish_attempts_submitted_stamp_check
publish_attempts_submitted_stamp_check.value: "publishing"."publish_attempts"."phase" <> 'submitted_awaiting_response' OR ("publishing"."publish_attempts"."content_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "publishing"."publish_attempts"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)

system_scoped.name: system_scoped
system_scoped.using: account_id = account.current_account_id() OR (account_id IS NULL AND account.current_account_id() IS NULL)
system_scoped.withCheck: account_id = account.current_account_id() OR (account_id IS NULL AND account.current_account_id() IS NULL)

queue_settings_retry_delays_check.name: queue_settings_retry_delays_check
queue_settings_retry_delays_check.value: cardinality("infra"."queue_settings"."retry_delays_seconds") >= 1 AND array_position("infra"."queue_settings"."retry_delays_seconds", NULL) IS NULL AND 1 <= ALL("infra"."queue_settings"."retry_delays_seconds") AND 86400 >= ALL("infra"."queue_settings"."retry_delays_seconds")
